tasks.title: Integrate Alchemy.run for Cloudflare Container Management
tasks.description: Set up Alchemy.run to manage our Cloudflare containers infrastructure using TypeScript-based cloud orchestration
tasks.details:
1) Install and configure Alchemy.run in our project
2) Set up container definitions using Alchemy's TypeScript API
3) Configure bindings for our existing D1 database and other Cloudflare services
4) Create deployment scripts that leverage Alchemy's orchestration capabilities
5) Test the integration with our current Cloudflare Workers setup

References:
- Alchemy.run: https://alchemy.run/
- Cloudflare Containers: https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/llms-full.txt
tasks.testStrategy: Create integration tests to verify Alchemy.run can successfully deploy and manage our Cloudflare containers, test database bindings, and validate deployment scripts

tasks.title: Feature Flag System Implementation
tasks.description: Create a JSON-based feature flag system for dynamic feature toggling without deployment
tasks.details:
1) Create feature_flags.json configuration file
2) Implement FeatureFlagService with runtime toggling
3) Add support for user-specific and global flags
4) Create admin interface for flag management
5) Add middleware for feature flag checks
6) Implement easy disable mechanism for post-beta features
7) Add feature flag validation and error handling
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for FeatureFlagService, integration tests for flag toggling, E2E tests for admin interface
